citations.quote: Residency: Australian citizen.

claims.claim: The applicant states she is an Australian citizen.

citations.quote: Copy of the applicant's Australian birth certificate attached and sighted by the Darwin housing office on 16 February 2026.

claims.claim: A copy of her Australian birth certificate was attached and sighted by the Darwin housing office on 16 February 2026.

citations.quote: the applicant declares that no household member owns or part owns residential property anywhere in Australia

claims.claim: The application form declares that no household member owns or part owns residential property in Australia.

citations.quote: I, Leanne Kestrel, declare that I do not own or part own residential property anywhere in Australia, and that no member of my household does.
Declared at Darwin on 16 February 2026 before an authorised witness.

claims.claim: A statutory declaration made before an authorised witness on 16 February 2026 states that neither she nor any household member owns or part owns residential property.

citations.quote: Income details: to follow.

claims.claim: Income details were not provided with the application and are marked as to follow.

citations.quote: The Income Confirmation Scheme form has not been signed.

claims.claim: The Income Confirmation Scheme form has not been signed.

citations.quote: If applying for urban social housing or private rental bond assistance, applicants must also qualify under additional income based criteria which are specified in the Income and Assets policy.

claims.claim: Urban applicants must also meet income-based criteria set out in the Income and Assets policy.

citations.quote: Statement date 15 Jan 2026.
Arrears balance $2,400.00. Payment plan proposed at $100 per fortnight.

claims.claim: A ledger dated 15 Jan 2026 shows a former tenancy debt to the CEO (Housing) of $2,400.00 with a proposed payment plan of $100 per fortnight.

citations.quote: Statement date 4 Mar 2026.
Arrears cleared in full. Balance $0.00.

claims.claim: A later ledger dated 4 Mar 2026 shows the arrears were cleared in full by a support agency payment, leaving a balance of $0.00, so the earlier ledger is out of date.

citations.quote: The provision of social housing will not be withheld based on a debt owed to the CEO (Housing).

claims.claim: Policy says social housing is not withheld because of a debt owed to the CEO (Housing).

citations.quote: Tenancy at a Palmerston property ended by mutual agreement on 12 June 2023.
No breach of the tenancy agreement recorded.

claims.claim: Her previous tenancy at a Palmerston property ended by mutual agreement on 12 June 2023 with no breach recorded.

citations.quote: A rent debt remained outstanding at exit.

claims.claim: A rent debt was outstanding when that tenancy ended, which the officer may weigh when judging whether there was evidence to justify a termination.

citations.quote: ended by mutual agreement on 12 June 2023
are ineligible to apply for social housing for a period of 2 years
Applicant: Leanne Kestrel (Ms K.).

claims.claim: The tenancy ended on 12 June 2023, more than 2 years before the application dated 2026-02-16.

citations.quote: Priority category claimed: domestic or family violence.

claims.claim: The applicant claims priority under the domestic or family violence category.

citations.quote: Ms K. and her two children are fleeing family violence and cannot safely return to their current address.

claims.claim: A support agency states she and her two children are fleeing family violence and cannot safely return to their current address.

citations.quote: Domestic or family violence.

claims.claim: Domestic or family violence is one of the listed urgent-need categories.

citations.quote: I am writing in support of Ms K.'s application for priority housing.
Case worker, Saltwater Lane Family Support.

claims.claim: The supporting document is a letter from a case worker at Saltwater Lane Family Support.

citations.quote: Case worker, Saltwater Lane Family Support.

claims.claim: The support letter does not name the case worker who signed it.

citations.quote: Police attended the property on 2 February 2026.

claims.claim: The letter says police attended the property on 2 February 2026, but no police report or reference is in the file.

citations.quote: Applicants must prove their urgent need for priority housing and are required to provide documentation that supports their claim for priority.

claims.claim: Policy requires applicants to prove urgent need with supporting documentation, as set out in the Identification and Documentation policy.

citations.quote: Priority housing applicants must meet the eligibility criteria for social housing, although the CEO (Housing) has some discretion for extreme situations.

claims.claim: Policy gives the CEO (Housing) some discretion for extreme situations when an eligibility criterion is unmet.

citations.quote: Household: the applicant and her two children, aged 7 and 10.

claims.claim: The household includes two children aged 7 and 10.

clauses.policy_sentence: Applicants must be an Australian citizen or have permanent residency status.
clauses.title: Residency

clauses.decides: Owns no residential property (a domestic or family violence exemption needs delegate approval).

missing.statement: The file holds no independent property search or title check to confirm the declaration.

clauses.policy_sentence: Except in Remote Communities, Town Camps and CLAs, applicants and tenants who own or partly own residential property anywhere in Australia are ineligible for social housing.
clauses.title: Residential property ownership

clauses.decides: Whether income evidence is in the file. The Income and Assets policy is not bundled, so v1 does not test the thresholds.

missing.statement: The file contains no income evidence such as payslips, Centrelink statements or bank statements.

clauses.policy_sentence: If applying for urban social housing or private rental bond assistance, applicants must also qualify under additional income based criteria which are specified in the Income and Assets policy.
clauses.title: Income criteria for urban applicants

clauses.decides: A debt to the CEO (Housing) does not withhold housing.
clauses.policy_sentence: The provision of social housing will not be withheld based on a debt owed to the CEO (Housing).
clauses.title: Debts

clauses.decides: A tenancy terminated for breach in the last 2 years means ineligible for 2 years.
clauses.policy_sentence: Former social housing tenants who have had their tenancy agreement terminated or have voluntarily vacated the premises leaving sufficient evidence to justify a termination (under breach of tenancy agreement conditions or satisfactory tenancy criteria), are ineligible to apply for social housing for a period of 2 years, which includes property under the management or ownership of the CEO (Housing).
clauses.title: Unsatisfactory former tenancies

clauses.decides: The applicant falls in one of the four urgent-need categories.
policy_items: Young person in the care of the Chief Executive Officer Territory Families, Housing and Communities transitioning to independence;
Serious medical or social problems; and
clauses.policy_sentence: The following categories are considered an urgent need for social housing:
clauses.title: Urgent-need category

clauses.decides: Urgent need is proven with supporting documentation (see the Identification and Documentation policy).

missing.statement: The file holds no police report, protection order or other independent document confirming the family violence.

clauses.policy_sentence: Applicants must prove their urgent need for priority housing and are required to provide documentation that supports their claim for priority.
clauses.title: Urgent need documented

clauses.decides: Whether the "some discretion for extreme situations" applies.

missing.statement: Nothing in the file asks for discretion, or says that an eligibility criterion is unmet because of an extreme situation.

clauses.policy_sentence: Priority housing applicants must meet the eligibility criteria for social housing, although the CEO (Housing) has some discretion for extreme situations.
clauses.title: Discretion for extreme situations

clauses.decides: Facts the writer found important that no clause names.

missing.statement: The file holds no identification documents for the two children.

clauses.title: Not on the checklist
